pro_course_detail.title: English Grammar Course
pro_course_detail.description: This course is aimed at Elementary Plus/Pre-intermediate students who would like to boost their understanding of English grammar. In this course we'll start with relatively basic grammar constructions, finishing with some complex and often confusing grammar concepts from the Upper-Intermediate and Advanced levels. The course will involve both theoretical studies and a lot of practice (both oral or written). It will be perfect for students who would like to prepare for international exams like TOEFL or IELTS (and other Cambridge exams) and are ok with doing a lot of homework. The length of the course is about 60-80 hours, but naturally I will tailor it to your level and needs. If you are unsure about your knowledge of grammar and would like a structured, systematic approach, this course will be ideal for you.

pro_course_detail.description:
General English lessons
Этот курс подойдет как новичкам, так и тем, кто уже изучает английский, но все еще чувствует себя недостаточно уверенно, чтобы перейти к урокам с носителями языка. Мы будем расширять словарный запас, обсуждать интересные и актуальные темы, вместе разбираться в тонкостях и сложных вопросах грамматики.

Along with textbooks, we will use audio, video material and texts from various up to date sources. Through interesting conversations, we will expand your vocabulary and together we will overcome all your issues with grammar.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation practice for all levels
pro_course_detail.description:
If you are a beginner, you will learn Russian conversation skills and start speaking Russian in the first lesson. I will teach you how to ask and answer simple questions, understand a native speaker and how to keep a conversation flowing.
For more advanced students these lessons are a great way to practice and expand their vocabulary. We will discuss topics which are interesting for you and master your ability to speak and understand Russian.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational practice from A1 to B1
pro_course_detail.description:
Conversational practice from A1 to B1
На этих уроках мы уделим особое внимание Вашим навыкам разговорной речи. Я буду поправлять Ваши ошибки и предлагать варианты, которые будут приближены к тому, как бы сказал носитель языка. Для расширения словарного запаса мы также можем использовать дополнительные материалы такие как тексты и статьи на разнообразные темы. 
In these sessions, we will focus on conversational skills, and I will provide corrections and suggestions where necessary. We can also use materials such as articles and texts for a variety of topics and to introduce new vocabulary.

My professional lessons are always structured. In each class, we take a certain lexical and grammar topic related to the topic of the previous lesson and practice it developing different types of skills with emphasis on speaking. I don't believe in the power of written grammar exercises. I provide interesting audio and video files, as well as exciting games for my students instead. I conducted research on using games in the language learning process that showed that, while playing students are so concentrated on the rules of the game and winning it that they use language without embarrassment, this is sometimes difficult to achieve in ordinary sessions. I don't prepare students for tests or examinations as I'm sure that these evaluation instruments have nothing to do with actually using the language.

В зависимости от уровня и имеющихся лакун, возраста, и интересов,  работаем с пособиями, разработанным для французских школ (обычно это интересные истории + грамматика и лексика).
